additional_concerns: Neither candidate has executable meaning. Retrieval PASS and LegalRuleML UNSUPPORTED establish no legal sufficiency or correspondence.

Paragraph 10 assigns continuing responsibility but does not supply a complete fulfillment test. Actual authority, consistent conduct, supervisory effectiveness, incident materiality, duration and remediation require standards and facts; neither candidate's proposed test is established as necessary and sufficient.

Paragraph 14 directly conditions demonstration on an SFC request. Confirmation remains unconditioned in its wording; footnote 5's unqualified formulation leaves an interpretive question about demonstration. The SFC-satisfaction standard directly attaches to demonstration, and its extension to confirmation is unresolved.

Without an SFC request, paragraphs 15 and 16 do not independently trigger procurement. Paragraph 15 specifies operational, record-keeping and smart-contract subjects; paragraph 16 concerns an opinion supporting the application. Neither procurement nor its absence determines paragraph 10 fulfillment.

Proper ownership records and operational compatibility are express substantive requirements. Their relationship to paragraph 10 supports examining outcomes, but does not establish strict liability for every incident or permit treating missing evidence as failure.
The complete paragraphs 10–13, footnote 2 and applicable Appendix factors are not supplied. Part B cannot be imported into the provider requirement solely from the separate intermediary provisions.
